# Zyrabit SLM

Zyrabit SLM is a Sovereign Local Model runtime and RAG engine built on Hexagonal Architecture.

## Architecture Summary
The system separates core domain logic from infrastructure using Ports and Adapters.
- Primary Adapters: FastAPI, Socket.IO
- Domain: Use Cases, Gatekeeper, PII Masking
- Ports: Interfaces defining infrastructure contracts
- Secondary Adapters: ChromaDB, Ollama, etc.

## Map
- Hexagonal Architecture: /docs/architecture/hexagonal
- Swap Database: /docs/guides/swap-database
- Configure Models: /docs/guides/swap-models
- Hardware Configuration: /docs/guides/swap-hardware
- AI Context: /docs/ai-context

## Ports & Adapters
- `InferencePort` -> `OllamaInferenceAdapter`
- `VectorStorePort` -> `ChromaAdapter`
- `McpClientPort` -> `InternalMcpClientAdapter`
